mapper.select: SELECT p.PLAN_IDX, p.PLAN_TITLE, p.END_TO, p.PLAN_SUB_END, p.IS_SHARED, p.IS_ACTIVE, p.PLAN_IMP, p.CERT_EXP, GROUP_CONCAT( CASE prd.DAY_IDX WHEN 1 THEN 'sun' WHEN 2 THEN 'mon' WHEN 3 THEN 'tue' WHEN 4 THEN 'wed' WHEN 5 THEN 'thu' WHEN 6 THEN 'fri' WHEN 7 THEN 'sat' END ORDER BY prd.DAY_IDX SEPARATOR ',' ) AS REPEAT_DAYS, p.FIRE_STATE, p.COLOR, p.DESCRIPTION FROM PLAN_TABLE p LEFT JOIN PLAN_REPEAT_DAYS prd ON p.PLAN_IDX = prd.PLAN_IDX WHERE p.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} AND p.IS_DELETED = 0 AND p.IS_COMPLETED = 0 GROUP BY p.PLAN_IDX, p.PLAN_TITLE, p.END_TO, p.PLAN_SUB_END, p.IS_SHARED, p.IS_ACTIVE, p.PLAN_IMP, p.CERT_EXP, p.FIRE_STATE, p.COLOR, p.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY p.IS_ACTIVE DESC, p.PLAN_IMP DESC, p.PLAN_SUB_START IS NULL, p.PLAN_SUB_START DESC

SELECT p.PLAN_IDX, p.PLAN_TITLE, p.END_TO, p.PLAN_SUB_END, p.IS_SHARED, p.IS_ACTIVE, p.PLAN_IMP, p.CERT_EXP, GROUP_CONCAT( CASE all_prd.DAY_IDX WHEN 1 THEN 'sun' WHEN 2 THEN 'mon' WHEN 3 THEN 'tue' WHEN 4 THEN 'wed' WHEN 5 THEN 'thu' WHEN 6 THEN 'fri' WHEN 7 THEN 'sat' END ORDER BY all_prd.DAY_IDX SEPARATOR ',' ) AS REPEAT_DAYS, p.FIRE_STATE, p.COLOR, p.DESCRIPTION FROM PLAN_TABLE p JOIN PLAN_REPEAT_DAYS today_prd ON p.PLAN_IDX = today_prd.PLAN_IDX AND today_prd.DAY_IDX = #{dayIdx} LEFT JOIN PLAN_REPEAT_DAYS all_prd ON p.PLAN_IDX = all_prd.PLAN_IDX WHERE p.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} AND p.IS_DELETED = 0 AND p.IS_COMPLETED = 0 AND p.IS_ACTIVE = 1 GROUP BY p.PLAN_IDX, p.PLAN_TITLE, p.END_TO, p.PLAN_SUB_END, p.IS_SHARED, p.IS_ACTIVE, p.PLAN_IMP, p.CERT_EXP, p.FIRE_STATE, p.COLOR, p.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY p.PLAN_IMP DESC, p.PLAN_SUB_START IS NULL, p.PLAN_SUB_START DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.PLAN_IDX) FROM PLAN_TABLE p JOIN PLAN_REPEAT_DAYS prd ON p.PLAN_IDX = prd.PLAN_IDX WHERE p.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} AND p.IS_DELETED = 0 AND p.IS_COMPLETED = 0 AND p.IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND prd.DAY_IDX = #{dayIdx}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.PLAN_IDX) FROM PLAN_TABLE P JOIN PLAN_REPEAT_DAYS prd ON P.PLAN_IDX = prd.PLAN_IDX WHERE P.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_COMPLETED = 0 AND P.IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND prd.DAY_IDX = #{dayIdx} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PLAN_ACTIVITY WHERE PLAN_IDX = P.PLAN_IDX AND IS_DELETED = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PLAN_ACTIVITY A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACTIVITY_IDX FROM VERIFY_TABLE WHERE VERIFY_DATE = CURDATE() ) V ON A.ACTIVITY_IDX = V.ACTIVITY_IDX WHERE A.PLAN_IDX = P.PLAN_IDX AND A.IS_DELETED = 0 AND V.ACTIVITY_IDX IS NULL )
